g3_infrastructure.fresh_checker_discrepancy: Isolated checkout replay failed on missing artifact certificates; original report gave PASS. This is a custody finding, not a mathematical result.

report_verbatim.cause: implementation-v2/v2_driver.py launches the independent comparator as [C.SAGE_PYTHON, C.COMPARATOR, cdir] with SAGE_PYTHON = /opt/conda-sage/envs/sage/bin/python (implementation-v2/v2_common.py:40). /opt/conda-sage does not exist on this host. Earlier GFPN runs recorded "Sage 10.9 (conda, /opt/conda-sage)" in environment.json; this container does not carry it.
report_verbatim.clears_when: a host with Sage at /opt/conda-sage/envs/sage/bin/python (as recorded by the earlier runs) is provisioned, and a Coordinator decision authorises a new launch; R5P-12 forbids a contingency id for a gate package, so it is not re-run inside this task.
report_verbatim.observed: raw-result.json: run_status failed, failure_class infrastructure_error, gate_pass false, reason "comparator did not complete". comparator/stdout.log and comparator/stderr.log are both empty (0 bytes).

report_verbatim.admission: The r5 wrapper itself admitted G4: its R-8 check requires the r5 checker verdict PASS on G3, which G3 carries; RB-4 gates only the post-gate packages.
report_verbatim.handling: G4 run package is preserved and committed as an immutable record; it is reported, not deleted. The Coordinator decides whether it is admissible.
report_verbatim.what: G4 (RUN-GFPN-0037fb) was launched at 2026-09-28T19:19:28Z, about 2 s AFTER G3 had ended failed. R5P-2 / the completion gate say that if any of G1..G4 failed, no later package exists.
report_verbatim.why: The session sequencer stopped only on a non-zero wrapper exit; the wrapper exited 0 for the failed G3 (the failure is in run_status, not the wrapper exit). The session then stopped the sequencer, but G4 had already been admitted.
report_verbatim.wrapper_exit_for_G4: not captured: the sequencer subshell that appends wrapper_exit was SIGSTOPped by the session and then killed, so the out file has no wrapper_exit line. The wrapper printed its own status line (quoted).

gate_and_rb4.reason: G3 gate_pass is false from infrastructure_error; report states no post-gate package runs. G4 was nevertheless launched after G3 failed and is a disclosed sequencing deviation, not an admissible post-gate sample.

report_outcome.scientific_evidence: none; a gate infrastructure failure is not a measurement
report_outcome.summary: STOPPED AT THE GATE. G1, G2 and G4 completed_valid with r5 checker PASS; REG-1 (d-parsed) PASS; G3 failed with failure_class infrastructure_error. Under R5P-2 no post-gate package runs. 4 of 31 reserved ids used; 23 planned packages and 4 contingency ids not attempted.

g3_discrepancy.interpretation: The source commit has no tracked certificates/ directory. Whether an empty directory existed during the original checker invocation is unverified. No source artifact was changed.
